prompt: In 501 darts a leg must finish on a double or the bullseye, scoring exactly the points needed. A player needs exactly 110 and will throw three darts. Which one both scores exactly 110 and finishes on a double?
explanation: Check both conditions for each: treble 20 + treble 15 + single 5 = 60 + 45 + 5 = 110 but ends on a single; treble 19 + treble 17 + single 2 = 57 + 51 + 2 = 110 but also ends on a single; treble 20 + single 16 + double 16 = 60 + 16 + 32 = 108, so it ends on a double but is 2 short. Treble 20 + single 20 + double 15 = 60 + 20 + 30 = 110 and ends on a double, so it finishes the leg.
